notes.title: Version 2 is Coming!
notes.content: [p]Shortly, we'll release a major version of UMPB that includes new characters and Steam Achievements![/p][p]Whilst we have been working on our new game (Steam store page coming soon), we've also been updating UMPB, as we want to give players a reason to keep coming back and getting the most out of our first release![/p][p]Stay tuned for the new version![/p][p]Tim & Carlos.[/p]

notes.title: Ultra Mega Planet Battles v1.0.0.2 Update
notes.content:
We're happy to announce update v1.0.0.2.

The update includes several quality of life improvements and minor bug fixes.

Happy playing!

notes.title: Ultra Mega Planet Battles v1.0.0.1 Update
notes.content:
[b]BUG FIXES[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed a rare issue with the Revive ability that stopped players from Reviving more than once during the same mission.
[*] Fixed an issue in one of the Story Transition screens where the incorrect player ships were showing.
[/list]

[b]IMPROVEMENTS[/b]

[list]
[*] Changed the Loading screen (where the player controls are displayed) to allow the player to continue into the game manually; i.e. so they can look at the controls for as long as required.
[/list]

notes.title: Ultra Mega Planet Battles launches!
notes.content:
Hi all,

We're ecstatic to announce that Ultra Mega Planet Battles has launched and is available to purchase now.

There is a 20% launch discount available for the next week on the Steam store.

We really hope you enjoy and have as much fun playing UMPB as we did making it!

Cheers, Tim and Carlos.

notes.title: NEW STEAM NEXT FEST DEMO RELEASED!
notes.content:
Hi all,

We’re excited to release a new verision of the UMPB demo for the 2024 Steam Next Fest event!

The new demo has the following improvements / changes:

[list]
[*] Improved level 1 design, with new background and weather effects.
[*] Improved level 1 boss design to make it more consistent with the overall look and feel of the game.
[*] New basic attacks for ships / mechs that launches ‘drunken missiles’ as at Attack levels 4 and 5.
[*] New trailing smoke animation for special missiles and drunken missiles.
[*] New in-game player comms that will trigger when playing certain levels.
[*] Improved UI / UX interaction when using KBM.
[*] Improved UI colours when using either KBM or Controller.
[*] Extended level 2 with additional rooms, enemies and pickups.
[*] Removed the timer on health pickups in level 2 that made them disappear, giving the player more time to pick them up.
[*] Various bug fixes.
[*] Various other general improvements.
[/list]

Importantly, this version of the demo contains the first 2 missions / levels of the game. All 8 missions will be available in the full release, coming Q1 2025.

We hope you enjoy the new version!

Take care, Tim and Carlos.

notes.title: New demo version that includes level 3
notes.content:
Hi all,

We have some exciting news!

A new version of the Ultra Mega Planet Battles demo is now available to download.

The new version contains the first 3 levels of the game. In level 3, you're controlling your Mech and escaping from the Brute base that was destroyed in level 2.

Also, the new version has a "16-BIT MODE" - toggle between a modern look and a classic 16-bit look. Start the game this way, or change mid-game in the pause menu!

We hope you enjoy the new version, and any feedback is very welcomed!

Thanks for all your support and interest...

Tim and Carlos.

notes.title: New demo version that includes level 2
notes.content:
Hi all,

We have some exciting news! 

A new version of the Ultra Mega Planet Battles demo is now available to download. 

The new version contains the first 2 levels of the game. In level 2, you now control a Mech that has jettisoned from your Raven ship.

We hope you enjoy the new version, and any feedback is very welcomed!

Thanks for all your support and interest...

Tim and Carlos.

notes.title: Happy New Year and Quick Update
notes.content:
Happy New Year all! We hope that 2024 treats you and your loved ones well.

A quick update. We've been busily working away on the new version of the demo, which includes the 2nd level of the game. We're in the final stages of play testing and should be releasing the new demo soon.

We've also made some small improvements to level 1 that will be included in the new version.

We can't wait to bring Ultra Mega Planet Battles to market in 2024...it will be a huge year for us!

Cheers, Tim and Carlos.

notes.title: Level 2 is coming soon!
notes.content:
Hi all,

Since launching the original demo, we've been working hard on level 2 of UMPB!

In this level you'll play as a mech warrior that has jettisoned from your ship. Defeat the enemies and avoid traps in each room as you make your way to the enemy base Power Core that you must destroy!

Level 2 will be released in a new version of the free playable demo in the next couple of months.

Thanks for all your support, and take care.

Tim and Carlos.

notes.title: Keyboard and Mouse support is here!
notes.content:
Hi all,

We're excited to let you know that KBM support for Ultra Mega Planet Battles is available.

Player 1 can either play with the KBM or a supported controller, whilst players 2-4 can play with supported controllers.

Thanks for all your support, and take care.

Tim and Carlos.
